content: To explore what happened with your Thunderbird installation we need several screen shots. Open Thunderbird, go to Help > Troubleshooting Information > Profile Folder > Open Folder..., then quit Thunderbird. in the profile folder xxxxxxxxx.default-release (or similar name) search for the prefs.js file and look up its size in kB. Also search for possible prefs-1.js (or in general prefs-x.js) files or an invalidprefs.js file and note creation date and size). Then go back in the folder hierarchy from the profile folder to its parent folder "Profiles" and take a screen shot of its contents. Thereafter go back one more step in the folder hierarchy and open the folder Thunderbird. It contains a file named profiles.ini: open this file with a simple text editor and make a screen shot of its contents.
